source_support: User-supplied candidate list dated 2026-11-27, preserved in supplied order below.
operation: Emit each string verbatim followed by its lowercase form. Deduplicate exact UTF-8 bytes in first-seen order. Record the list before testing each string once on each cc.ENVELOPES entry using cc.try_envelope with gsmg only.

predicted_artifact.detail: Run cc.find_keys on the saved bytes of every strict pad-valid plaintext (pad 1 through 16) and check both Half and Better Half. Report all retained plaintexts even without a matching key.

acceptance_rule: Report all real pad lengths >=2, and inspect every retained output for coherent text, with printable fraction recorded. A key hit requires a target match from cc.find_keys. Count planted results separately. A failed control invalidates the real run.

controls.harness: cc.selftest must pass, including opening the known Phase 3.2 envelope.
